title: decrypt.rs: AES-GCM branch checks OID but immediately errors — dead dispatch
description: decrypt.rs lines 58-64 match ID_AES_128_GCM and ID_AES_256_GCM only to return UnsupportedAlgorithm with a message explaining why. These OIDs are never used in standard EnvelopedData, so matching them before the catch-all provides no value — the catch-all would produce a cleaner and equally informative error. The specific match arm exists to explain a protocol distinction (GCM belongs in AuthEnvelopedData), but that explanation belongs in a code comment at the catch-all, not as a dispatch arm that will never be hit in practice. Suggested rewrite: remove the explicit GCM arm and add a comment to the catch-all explaining that GCM in EnvelopedData is not valid per RFC and would appear as an unknown OID.
close_reason: labeled opinion; engineering rationale in MIME-72l.57 (explicit error > generic unknown-OID)
